notes: Names, types and words are placeholders until the child decides. All battle numbers are exact; there is no randomness anywhere.

rules.damage_formula: final = max(0, base (+2 if Lift) (+1 if Fresh) + typeBonus - (target folded this round ? 1 : 0))
order_of_round: show enemy card (its form + action, numbers already computed)
player chooses one action (no turn timer); preview shows final numbers
if enemy (or last shield) is gone: battle/phase ends, enemy card does NOT happen
if active character has 0 hearts: it becomes Sleepy; player picks next awake character for free
rules.battle_start: lead enters folded; enemy strip at card 1 (card 1 skipped if enemy is Dizzy)
rules.fold_change: Fold/Open uses the turn. It takes effect immediately, before the enemy card resolves.
rules.folded: takes 1 less from every hit (never below 0); folded moves only
rules.open: takes full hits; open moves only
rules.switch: uses the turn; incoming character arrives folded and receives the enemy card; outgoing character folds and drops Lift badge and tummy
rules.sleepy: at 0 hearts; cannot battle or lead or use field powers until a rest spot; next character chosen for free (enemy does not act)
rules.lose: all three Sleepy -> team wakes at last rest blanket with full hearts; all creatures awake at spawns; used Candy Apples gone; candy, puzzles, stamps kept
rules.run: always works vs creatures (ends battle before enemy acts; creature ignores you 3 s); not allowed vs boss
rules.heal_cap: heals never go above max hearts and never wake a Sleepy character
rules.rest_spot: walk onto blanket: all characters full hearts and awake; all sleeping creatures wake back at their spawns; autosave
rules.after_win: fanfare; creature drops candy and sleeps at spawn until next rest
rules.fresh: After Open, the first damaging move while open gets +1 (sparkle badge). Lost if you Fold first.

status.sticky: Web intent: during the round the Web card shows, NOTHING is locked and no buttons appear locked (the player acts first). When Web resolves at round end: big wrapping animation webs over the Fold/Open and Team buttons and the Sticky badge appears. Applies to the next turn only, then the web snaps off.
status.dizzy: sneak attack: enemy skips its first card

bag.sold_at: treat stand at every rest blanket

rules.boss_loss_hint: after losing to the boss, respawn at the pumpkin rest blanket; the type-wheel icon glows on the portrait of the teammate strong against the boss type (Ice Cream) until the next attempt; no words

characters.role: counter-puncher: eats the enemy's attack and burps it back

field_power.needs: facing an adjacent boulder; auto-unfolds if folded

moves.rules: Usable only with empty tummy. If this round's enemy card is an attack, take 0 from it and store EXACTLY the final number its intent bubble showed (against the open Monster). Tummy badge shows that same number. No attack on the card: nothing stored.
Usable only with a full tummy. Base = stored number (no bonus), then Fresh, type and fold rules. The button shows the final damage. Empties tummy.

presentation.style: Paper Page: world drawn in marker on white paper; characters from scans of the real drawings
presentation.layers: 3 paper layers (paper texture / ground+objects / front cut-outs) with drop shadows; parallax up to 10 px
presentation.light: warm late-afternoon tint, vignette, lantern pools in ghost house
presentation.sketch_in: decorative scenery draws in as marker strokes then fill over 0.6 s on first view; gameplay objects always fully drawn before within 6 tiles
presentation.camera: ease to 1.12x over 1.0 s near creatures (4 tiles) or in puzzle areas; snap to 1.2x on spotted; Steady camera setting
presentation.unfold: paper hinge: 0.5 s field, 0.8 s battle; first unfold per character = 2 s hero version (push-in, dim, bloom, fanfare, name card), skippable
presentation.battle: page-turn transition 0.6 s; hit flash; marker damage numbers; 4+ damage and Smash/Burp/Howl = 60 ms hit-stop + screen shake; confetti + fanfare on win
presentation.boss_intro: letterbox bars in, slow push-in as Big Ghost rises, Little Ghosts spiral, marker title card BIG GHOST, drum hit, boss theme, bars out at round 1
presentation.sound: real paper fold recordings; per-character attack sounds; same action same sound; bright candy chimes; field/battle/boss themes; fast Candy Dash version

flat_character_rule: Flat characters have one form: never fold, always take full hits, always have all moves, field powers work without opening.

Collected candy becomes keys: gumdrop locks show a candy kind and open when you give one from the jar. Each Book candy slot fills a factory recipe page; full pages unlock candy-shop items.

battle_display.move_cards: picture + one short word + one big marker digit = final number (type, fold, Fresh, Lift applied); button symbol in corner
battle_display.badge_moves: badge icon with digit (Lift 2, Gulp = number it would store, Burp = final damage)
battle_display.intent_bubble: one big digit = final damage to current character in current form
